title: SB1 people rows in the phone drawer (vs Messages' conversations drawer)

spec.exclude_note: The sidebar foot is F2's SidebarFoot, not a rows part; this run measures the rows.
spec.accent_note: The Studio tints its light mode with the wallpaper's hue (168); the kit's tokens are the default accent (258), so the spec is pinned to it.

states.name: drawer
states.about: Messages at phone width with its conversations open

pairs_note: No structure pair: the surface fills its window, so the window's own frame paint would be read as the sidebar's.
phone_note: Run with --phone only. The spec's window is the drawer card itself, so the GTK surface is SidebarToggle's card filling its window.
